speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: asked the Minister for National Development in circumstances where low-income parents who co-own their HDB flats with their children decide to sell their flats to enable their children to be removed as co-owners so that the children can buy flats in their own names, whether HDB can allow these parents to rely on their children's income in deciding whether or not to grant a concessionary loan for a purchase of a second flat in the parents' names.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: As each family may have unique circumstances, I would suggest that they approach HDB to explore the possible options so that they can sustain their housing arrangements.
